linkedin_text:
Not every lead deserves your calendar invite.

When you're running a small business, chasing the wrong prospects doesn't just waste an afternoon—it drains your energy. The trick isn't talking to more people; it's talking to the right ones.

A lead is usually worth your time if they check three simple boxes: they have a specific problem (not just vague curiosity), they have an actual timeline to fix it, and they genuinely engage when you reply.

Setting up simple automations to spot these cues early lets you focus on real conversations that actually turn into growth.

How do you usually spot a dream client versus a tire-kicker?
